scope: inner-life system: needs, emotions/thoughts, stress, personality facets, preferences as exposed by DFHack plugins + Lua API
caveat: df-structures XML submodule NOT present in this clone; full enum value lists (unit_thought_type, emotion_type, need_type, trait_type, value_type, goal_type) live upstream in df-structures. Enum members listed here are only those observed in DFHack sources.

structure_path.note: No soul -> DFHack defaults getStressCategory to middle (3 = 'fine').

stress.accumulator: personality.stress (int32 raw level; sort.lua uses this field)
stress.display_level: personality.stress_level (manipulator.cpp uses this field; rendered as 6-digit int clamped to [-99999, 999999])
stress.decay: handled by vanilla DF, not DFHack; DFHack only reads categories
stress.cutoffs_semantics: category i where stress_level >= cutoffs[i]; 0 = highest stress, 6 = lowest

fields_observed.thought: df.unit_thought_type (e.g. SoapyBath) -- the trigger event ('has been without drink', 'slept on the floor' style enum keys live in df-structures)
fields_observed.severity: int (set equal to strength by misery.cpp)
fields_observed.flags.whole: bitfield; DFHack parks FAKE_EMOTION_FLAG at bit (1<<30) to mark plugin-injected emotions for later removal

emotions_thoughts.trigger_effect_chain: event -> unit_thought_type instance + emotion_type + strength/severity + timestamp appended to personality.emotions -> vanilla DF aggregates into personality.stress -> stress category 0..6 -> UI icon/tooltip/column -> at thresholds gates Fell/Macabre moods and tantrums
emotions_thoughts.injection_example: misery.cpp daily cycle (CYCLE_TICKS=1229): append MISERY/SoapyBath emotion to every citizen, clearable via misery_clear which removes all emotions with FAKE_EMOTION_FLAG
emotions_thoughts.game_ui_tabs: view sheets Thoughts tab: sub-tab 0 Recent, 1 Memories (Gui.cpp focus string)

instance_fields_observed.focus_level: int; -999 (desperate) .. +400 (satisfied) per autolabor modernengine.cpp comment; negative = unmet

needs.focus_penalty_api: dfhack.units.getFocusPenalty(unit, need_type...) -> largest (most negative) focus_level among matching needs; returns >400 if unit lacks the need
needs.locked_in_threshold: focus_level <= -10000 makes a social activity 'unbailable' (purple 'Socialize!'/Prayer/Read cannot be interrupted) -- Units::hasUnbailableSocialActivity

api: dfhack.units.getGoalName(unit, goalIndex) (achieved short-name variant when done)

mental_stability_formula_sortlua.description: weighted linear composite; higher = more stable; used as tiebreak sort

dwarfmonitor_cpp: ViewscreenFortStats: fort activity percentages over 28/84-day rolling windows, job->category folding
ViewscreenPreferences: fort-wide preference co-occurrence; dwarf list annotated with stress category name+color; reads unit_preference.active only
dwarfmonitor_lua: MiseryWidget: 'H:' + 7 slash-separated citizen counts, one per stress category (getCategory+1), colored per category
sort_stressicons_lua: overlay scanning the top bar 'Pop' label to find the 7 stress face icons; clicking a face lists citizens in that category and zooms to them
sort_lua: sort widgets: 'stress level' (desc/asc on personality.stress, stress faces as rating labels)
'need for training' (MartialTraining focus_level bucketed to stress faces)
spectate: tooltip-follow-stress / tooltip-hover-stress: stress emoticon+color per category; configurable via tooltip-stress-levels (level name text pen)
manipulator: Stress column: raw stress_level 6-digit render, 5-color ladder via getStressCategoryRaw
misery: write-side: inject/remove fake MISERY emotions at configurable strength

trigger_effect_chains.trigger: thought event (df.unit_thought_type, e.g. SoapyBath; vanilla keys incl. 'has been without drink', 'slept on the floor' live in df-structures)
trigger_effect_chains.immediate: emotion instance (emotion_type + strength/severity + year/year_tick) pushed to personality.emotions
effects: stress category 0-6 -> icon counts, faces, tooltips, columns
longterm_stress >=20000/50000/100000 -> 10%/50%/100% chance Fell or Macabre mood (strangemood.cpp)

trigger_effect_chains.immediate: focus penalty = most negative focus_level; <= -10000 pins unit into uninterruptible Socialize/Prayer/Read activity
effects: autolabor modernengine biases laborer_pull/idle_pull/favored skills by urgency=min(-focus,400)/8
sort.lua buckets MartialTraining deficit into stress-face ratings
28/84-day rolling activity windows per dwarf and fort-wide
idle/leisure detection via social activities and Migrant misc trait

files.plugins/dwarfmonitor.cpp: stats screens, preference screen, stress category labels/colors
files.plugins/lua/sort/stressicons.lua: top-bar stress face overlay + category names
files.plugins/misery.cpp: emotion injection/clear, personality_moodst field usage, FAKE_EMOTION_FLAG
files.library/modules/Units.cpp: stress_cutoffs, getStressCategory(Raw), getFocusPenalty, needs sets, goals
files.library/LuaApi.cpp: Lua exposure: getStressCategory, getStressCategoryRaw, getStressCutoffs, getFocusPenalty, getGoalName, isGoalAchieved
files.library/modules/Gui.cpp: view sheet focus strings: Thoughts/Recent/Memories, Personality/Traits/Values/Preferences/Needs tabs
